concurrency: Coordinator, contracts, fixture and discriminator conversations can work concurrently. Sol reviews once their evidence is ready; diagnosis follows without assuming a campaign ran. Up to six reasoning conversations total including coordinator and any expert; queue Astra or reuse the expert slot when necessary. At most four admitted test processes, eight CPU cores and 16 GiB; serialize shared build and nested writers. Keep original two-hour horizon and deadlines; actual study runs no campaign.
reuse: Continue existing contracts, fixture and coordinator conversations, and reuse expert for independent design review and diagnosis. The discriminator scout supplies bounded missing evidence rather than repeating complete mappings; fixture work retains its established owner. Review remains independent of patch authorship.

expert_and_human_triggers.sol: Review consequential measurement design before substantial implementation, own interpretation of the reported miss and any exhausted repair or scope change, and independently review any patch before acceptance.
expert_and_human_triggers.astra: Consult promptly when strategic uncertainty, contradicted assumptions, expensive wrong turns or diminishing returns remain after bounded investigation.
expert_and_human_triggers.human: Request material tolerances and representativeness clarification early, and seek access to the operator's underlying evidence where available; clarify whether the proposed strict targets are desired. Continue independent analysis pending optional answers. Silence does not authorize execution or project changes. Escalate contract conflicts and consequential tradeoffs.

rejected_research: Do not infer chunk causality: the reported rows vary offset, level, noise and chunking together.
Do not call the apparent interval miss reproduced or use four rows as a campaign denominator.
Defer broad literature searches, hardware studies and algorithm modification until a specific evidence gap justifies them; do not weaken coverage or acceptance targets.
assumptions_and_uncertainties: E1 is hypothetical external summary feedback, not a report from any assignment in this plan; source path, build, PCM, seeds, publication semantics and counts are unknown.
The 0.10 Hz threshold concerns absolute truth error, not necessarily interval half-width; empirical coverage is evaluated separately for every finite interval.
Actual execution, build and project mutation remain outside this paper study and require represented authorization; deadline and resource constraints remain unchanged.
